rules.original_symptom: Bare Run RED/GREEN shorthand remained across later K3 tasks.
rules.root_cause: Task execution text depended on interpretation outside the task section.
rules.prevention_rule: Reject bare execution shorthand and require exact commands plus expected outcomes in each task contract.

rules.original_symptom: A reusable state CLI regression pinned the pre-H0 main SHA.
rules.root_cause: Dynamic execution state was encoded as a static literal.
rules.prevention_rule: Resolve live execution refs from validated state/runtime and reject stale dynamic pins.

rules.original_symptom: Workflow tests asserted an inline cp -R implementation detail.
rules.root_cause: A boundary contract test was coupled to one implementation mechanism.
rules.prevention_rule: Prefer externally observable boundary behavior and allow structural assertions only when text is normative.

rules.original_symptom: A new chat/session could be mistaken for an independent reviewer.
rules.root_cause: Review independence was inferred from session shape instead of observed capability.
rules.prevention_rule: Record review_mode truthfully and require actual independent execution before claiming independence.

rules.original_symptom: Local worktree execution was unavailable in the active harness.
rules.root_cause: Runtime capabilities were assumed instead of observed.
rules.prevention_rule: Represent required capabilities explicitly and fail closed when unavailable or unknown.

rules.original_symptom: Static Project startup files lagged live repository state.
rules.root_cause: Mutable execution status was duplicated into bootstrap files.
rules.prevention_rule: Keep bootstrap static and gate execution on verified bootstrap revision plus live CURRENT-STATE.

rules.original_symptom: Recording final run IDs in the verified branch would change the exact head being verified.
rules.root_cause: Final evidence and verified code head were coupled into a self-reference loop.
rules.prevention_rule: Keep final exact-head evidence external to the exact verified head and checkpoint it later.

rules.original_symptom: Multiple workflow jobs previously shared ambiguous check names.
rules.root_cause: Required check identity was not unique and stable.
rules.prevention_rule: Require unique stable check identities for mandatory CI gates.

rules.original_symptom: Process hardening could accidentally include K3 Task 5 product files.
rules.root_cause: Process work lacked a machine-enforced changed-file boundary.
rules.prevention_rule: Validate every task diff from task_base_sha against explicit allowed and forbidden paths.

rules.original_symptom: A generic import/setup failure could be mistaken for proof of missing behavior.
rules.root_cause: RED failure class was not explicitly classified.
rules.prevention_rule: Require accepted behavioral RED evidence and reject unrelated setup/import/environment failures.

rules.original_symptom: An execution branch can outlive the main SHA it was based on.
rules.root_cause: Execution proceeded without binding branch state to live main.
rules.prevention_rule: Bind execution to base_main_sha and block when live main differs.

rules.original_symptom: Execution annotations can change the approved spec/plan blob SHA.
rules.root_cause: Derived execution contracts can silently become stale.
rules.prevention_rule: Bind packets to approved spec/plan blob hashes and fail closed on mismatch.

rules.original_symptom: Lower-reasoning execution required reading broad historical context.
rules.root_cause: The executor lacked a minimal one-task working set.
rules.prevention_rule: Compile one-task packets and supply only the current task working set.

rules.original_symptom: An executor may improvise when a required tool or capability is absent.
rules.root_cause: No explicit downgrade/block path existed for missing capabilities.
rules.prevention_rule: Observe capabilities explicitly; use only approved fallbacks; otherwise return RUNTIME_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED.
